meta.title: EarLocAlert — Bus, shuttle and subway stop alarm, vibration and earphones only
meta.description: Never miss your stop on the bus, shuttle, subway or train. Pin a place on the map and EarLocAlert vibrates when you arrive, or plays a sound only through connected earphones, never the speaker. Your trips are not sent to any server.

faq.title: Questions
items: Can it wake me up before my bus or subway stop?
Yes. Save your stop or station on the map and your phone vibrates the moment you enter that radius — even with the app closed and the screen off.
Does it work on shuttles, commuter buses and trains?
Yes. It works on any trip with a place to get off: buses, shuttles, commuter buses, subways, trains and intercity buses. Save the stop or station on the map and give it a generous radius.
Does it make a sound without earphones?
No. It plays a sound only after confirming wired, USB-C or Bluetooth earphones are connected. Otherwise it only vibrates and never uses the speaker.
It does not keep GPS on. Far from your places it relies on the system’s geofencing, and only checks precisely when you get close.
Is my location sent to a server?

No. Arrival is detected on your phone and your trips are never sent to a server. There is no account. If you turn on Google Drive sync in Pro, only your list of places is saved to the app's private folder in your own Google Drive.
Can I get alerts on my smartwatch?
Yes. If your Galaxy Watch or Apple Watch mirrors phone notifications, arrival alerts reach your wrist. Settings › Get alerts on your watch shows how.
Downloading and the basics are free: one place, the default alerts, and ads. A one-time Pro purchase adds more places and removes ads. Ads never appear on the screen that is alerting you.
